Key takeaways
• Result: facilitation of the certification process, increased 
understanding of what is required for certification
• Result: improved repository practices and documentation through 
self-assessments
• Result: feedback from repositories to improve certification
• Varying repository types, practices and levels of maturity
• Notable differences in resources available
• Need for increased cooperation and peer-to-peer networks not only 
in terms of certification but also other aspects of repository practices
